newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends near lows after volatile day.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends near lows after volatile day.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures ended weaker on Thursday with volatile products futures and bouts of profit taking causing Brent to fluctuate wildly in peaks and troughs, traders said.

The February Brent contract last traded 22 cents down at $24.58 a barrel near the bottom of the day's range with the only constant being the Feb/March backwardation which held around 55 cents a barrel for most of the day.
The contract surged to testing trendline resistance at $24.90 then fell sharply to new intraday lows as NYMEX heating oil and gasoline came under pressure.
"One minute Brent was eyeing six year highs (at $25.06 a barrel) the next it was making new lows," one IPE floor broker said.
Earlier gas oil futures had ended firmer, closing before NYMEX heating fell sharply.
The market retained most of it's morning gains built on the back of cold weather in Europe and forecasts of deteriorating weather conditions in the U.S..
Jan gas oil ,which expires on Friday, ended $3.50 up at $234 a tonne in mid-range after hitting $235.25 on early buying and dipping to $232.75 on profit taking.
